meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会检查本机 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 的安装状态,和最新源码逐一对比,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上命令输出或文件作为证据。诊断期间不改动你的安装、配置和仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查,提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai 等关键词,或在安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 表现异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex doctor,看安装有没有问题
我的 Codex 装完之后行为很怪,帮我体检一下
say.note: 跑非递归探针并附上证据

say.text: 把我本地的 LazyCodex 安装和最新源码对比一下

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it with the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites its evidence. It never changes your install or config while diagnosing.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or lazycodex-ai, or when Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor and check my install health
My Codex acts oddly after installing - please diagnose it
say_en.note: Runs non-recursive probes and shows evidence

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex install against the latest source
say_en.note: Flags drift between local and upstream
